title: New Birth
definition: The new birth is God's work of giving spiritual life to those who were dead in sin.
summary: No one enters God's kingdom by natural birth, religious effort, or moral reform alone. A person must be born again by the Spirit.
christFocus: Jesus taught that sinners must be born again to enter the kingdom of God.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: No one enters God's kingdom by natural birth, religious effort, or moral reform alone. A person must be born again by the Spirit.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers know God rightly, follow Christ faithfully, and avoid confusion in doctrine and daily life.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your worship, obedience, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
